title: Epicardial restraint
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Heart exterior
views.title: Locate the envelope below the atria
views.lesson: Seen from the front and left, the mesh surrounds the outside of both ventricles and stays open at its base, below the atria and great vessels. The chambers come from a real heart model; the ventricular surfaces have small pits closed for display. The mesh shape and its basal edge are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the tissue–device relationship
views.lesson: Follow the mesh around the outside of the ventricular envelope, leaving the base open.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Alternate section

views.lesson: This alternate view keeps the same representative geometry and state.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: REPRESENTATIVE OUTER ENVELOPE
wall.body: The smooth ventricular envelope represents the outside of the heart. It is not a blood-pool cast or measured epicardium.

mesh.label: EXTERNAL RESTRAINT MESH
mesh.body: A generic network sits outside the representative ventricular surface. Material stiffness and constraint are not computed.

rim.label: BASAL OPENING
rim.body: The envelope is open at its base. The illustrated rim distinguishes the exterior mesh from an intracavitary implant.

region_LV.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_LV.body: The mesh lies over the outside of the left ventricle, up to the apex.

region_RV.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_RV.body: The mesh also covers the outside of the right ventricle, bridging the groove between the two ventricles.

region_LA.label: LEFT ATRIUM
region_LA.body: The left atrium sits above the basal opening of the mesh, outside it.

region_RA.label: RIGHT ATRIUM
region_RA.body: The right atrium sits above the basal opening of the mesh, outside it.

region_AO.label: AORTA
region_AO.body: The aorta rises from the base of the heart, above the mesh.

region_PA.label: PULMONARY ARTERY
region_PA.body: The pulmonary artery rises in front of the aorta, above the mesh.

region_mesh.label: EXTERNAL RESTRAINT MESH
region_mesh.body: A generic network lies outside both ventricles. Material stiffness and constraint are not computed.

region_rim.label: BASAL EDGE
region_rim.body: The mesh ends below the groove between atria and ventricles and stays open there. The edge position is representative.
